description:
1 litre vacuum insulated stainless steel flask is the go-to hot and cold water bottle for office, gym, travel, and long outdoor days. The double wall vacuum insulation with copper lining helps keep tea and coffee hot for up to 12 hours and water cold for up to 24 hours, so you’re not stuck with lukewarm drinks halfway through the day. Its leak‑proof lid makes it bag-safe, while the matte powder-coated finish gives a dry, slip-resistant grip that feels premium in the hand.

Built from food-grade 18/8 stainless steel, it’s a reusable, BPA-free alternative to single-use plastic bottles. The 1000ml capacity means fewer refills during meetings, classes, hikes, or road trips. If you want one dependable thermos flask that stays cold, stays hot, and won’t spill in your backpack, this is the everyday upgrade worth carrying.
